value.text: Dashboard serves saved place cards and accepts save and forecast-refresh requests for Places. It also consumes weather.place-requested and weather.forecast-updated events to maintain local cards. Six HTTP roots are GET /, GET /api/weather, POST /api/places, POST /api/places/{id}/refresh, GET /health, and GET /openapi.json. Source start connects Kafka, subscribes from the beginning to both topics, starts the shared consumer with autoCommit false, registers those routes, then listens; this source sequence does not establish runtime activation. The consumer validates recognized topic/event pairs and applies valid events transactionally. Parse or validation failures are persisted before offset plus one is committed; persistence failure prevents the commit, while an unknown topic throws UNKNOWN_TOPIC. The event schema and OpenAPI file are declarations, not proof of runtime enforcement. The capture uses TypeScript source syntax with declared dialect 7.0.2 and file-only browser, contract, schema, and database inputs; runtime and compiler validation remain UNKNOWN. See GET / for browser behavior and each HTTP operation for its declared contract.
